$description: Quill, the app kit: the rail and drawer every app frame is built from, and depth and focus (PDR-010). Edit tokens here only; scripts/build-tokens.mjs generates everything else.

measure-rail.$description: An app's side rail (ui-app-frame): its sections and one action. Between the widths Artifacts and Mandate had chosen by hand.

measure-drawer.$description: An app's right drawer (ui-app-frame): what can be done with what's on screen, its filters and its settings.

ring-gap.$description: How far the radial menu's ring of actions sits beyond the edge of the thing it was opened on, so the ring never covers its own subject.

ring-button.$description: One action's round button in the radial menu: a comfortable target for a pointer or a finger.

ring-radius.$description: The radial menu's radius when it is opened on a row rather than a tile: centred where it was opened, beside the row.

reel-card.$description: One card on a front page reel (a lane of what needs you, what's new, what's coming).

depth-blur.$description: Rack focus (PDR-010): how far the out-of-focus plane blurs when focus moves to an active surface (a dialog, the radial menu, the palette). Strips fine detail; the layout stays where it was, so you keep your bearings.

depth-saturate.$description: Rack focus: how much colour the out-of-focus plane keeps. Lowering saturation dials back peripheral noise without the black of a scrim.

depth-scale.$description: Depth decoupling: the out-of-focus plane shrinks this much, as a lens does when it refocuses on something closer.

depth-tint.$description: The faint slate the rack focus veil adds over the out-of-focus plane, so text behind it never competes. A tenth of slate-deep: never a scrim.

ambient-blur.$description: Focus pull (PDR-010): the soft blur on ambient things while something else has pulled focus. Under a pixel, so words stay readable.

ambient-saturate.$description: Focus pull: the colour ambient things keep while something else has pulled focus.

ambient-brightness.$description: Focus pull: how bright ambient things stay while something else has pulled focus.

path-dim.$description: Navigation path (PDR-010): the opacity of a tree's rows beside the path you took. The path stays lit at full strength. 0.66 keeps dimmed words at 4.5:1 on slate.
